testcase_checks.evidence: Gaslamp-like glazed flame fixtures, soot-dark masonry street, stone canal railing, horse/carriage and a covered pedestrian form a coherent period-city proxy. This is not historical provenance.

A pale humanlike spirit and lower plume at the valve connection are visible, but the cabinet cap hides the route between the lower plume and the upper spirit as well as a portion of the cabinet-to-lamp supply line. Similar glow does not prove full continuity; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS.

The woman retains a short dark bob with wispy fringe, large dark eyes, delicate face shape and similar lips/chin to the supplied portrait. The three-quarter lighting changes appearance; this is visible resemblance, not identity verification.

Both hands have plausible ownership and reach. The lower right hand grips the valve knob, while the upper left hand rests on the fixed cabinet roof/cap rather than holding the open door outer edge. The intended two-target action is not realized.
The face, purposeful near-hand action, pale spirit and bright flame organize one grounded wet-night photograph; gaslit city and supernatural presence are readable together.

artistic_observations.impression_before_control_labels: A quiet but visibly uncanny civic night shift; the worker watches the flame while her hands stay engaged with the fixture. The wet burgundy coat, luminous face and dense reflections give a persuasive cinematic portrait.
strengths: Face and hands carry attention before the smaller period street cues.
The glowing spirit is distinct from surrounding masonry and ordinary amber lamps.
Brass, glass rain droplets, wool and stone have convincing photographic texture.
limits: The figure is idealized and the spirit highly polished; the actual image supports less bureaucratic story detail than the authored narrative.
A beautiful general scene does not repair the wrong door contact or hidden full route.
artistic_observations.control_calibration: Subtle personal magnetism is visible in attentive bearing and face light; no added fetish focus is apparent. Explicit fantasy remains present under surreal=0. Perceived intensity is an author observation, not a numeric perceptual proof.
